welcome.text: Welcome to Animal Habitats! Let's help these cute animals find their correct homes!

instructions.text: Tap an animal first, then tap the habitat where it lives to match them!

correct_1.text: Great job! That's the perfect home for them!

correct_2.text: You got it! They look so happy in their home!

correct_3.text: Nice match! That's exactly where they belong!

correct_4.text: Wonderful! You found the right home!

wrong_1.text: Oops! That animal doesn't live there. Let's try again!

wrong_2.text: Not quite! Think about where that animal likes to play.

wrong_3.text: Try again! That habitat belongs to a different animal.

encouragement_2.text: You're a natural animal helper! Keep going!

encouragement_3.text: Just a few more animals to help! You've got this!

win.text: Fantastic! Every single animal is safely back in their correct home! You are an amazing helper!

try_again.text: Good effort! Let's play again and match them all!
